specification.title: Forbidden records fail the baseline even when retrieved
specification.description: Deliberately failing expectation: the structurally successful retrieval of the technique must fail the baseline because the scenario forbids that exact record.
specification.purpose: Verify the deliberately failing expectation: a structurally successful retrieval of the forbidden technique record must FAIL the baseline.
specification.operational_relevance: Negative tests prove the baseline can actually fail, protecting the evaluator from always-green behavior.
specification.regression_risk: A regression in the evaluator could turn an intentionally failing case into a pass.

required: The retrieval of the forbidden technique record is marked as a failure
forbidden: The forbidden record is treated as an acceptable retrieval
